newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Pacific BBA to build Thai brake plant.
newsitem.headline: Pacific BBA to build Thai brake plant.

text.p: Pacific BBA Ltd said on Tuesday its automotive brake manufacturing division, PBR, won a deal to supply disc brake calipers to a vehicle manufacturer in Thailand and would build a plant there to fill the order.
The company said it would invest A$13 million in land, buildings and plant in Thailand and expected production to start in mid-1998 with full production reached by the year 2000.

"Although it is not a big investment, strategically this is a very important step for us as it is another piece in our global manufacturing base," Pacific BBA's managing director Barry Jackson told a media briefing.
Jackson said the company had also recently acquired two small clutch rebuilding businesses in Sydney and Melbourne with the aim of gaining some expertise in this area.
"This business is becoming big world wide and we want to learn about it so we have the opportunity to expand into offshore markets if we want to," Jackson said.

He said the company also saw an opportunity created by the growth of small manual gear vehicle imports into Australia in the last few years, reversing the trend towards automatic gear vehicles in Australia.
